fields.title: Design Degradation
fields.promptBlocks/0/text: What do we show when each component fails and is an emergency switch needed?
fields.promptBlocks/1/text: Personalized discounts service 2. Geocoding service 3. Reviews service 4. Checkout service
fields.referenceReasoningBlocks/0/text: 1 — base prices without discounts, switch is needed. 2 — saved addresses work, new ones entered with manual map selection, switch not needed. 3 — product page without reviews block, switch is needed. 4 — no degradation, this is the core; the answer is redundancy, not a stripped-down mode. Rule of thumb: if the product loses core value without a component, degradation is not applicable.
